widgets.text: Health is the bar on screen; lives are lost when it empties. Pick-ups refill health and ammo.
Bosses are mostly armoured vehicles and gunships: keep moving, crouch under the fire and use rockets or grenades when they stop.
widgets.title: Tips

widgets.text: A bio-weapon plot; adds more vehicle and sniper sections and a gas-mask style survival theme. Each mission ends with a password.
Free hostages and pick up intel for score.
Missions unlock in order; passwords save your place.
